aiPoints.body: It answers only from rights information and organisations that LINKRIGHTS has reviewed and registered.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.subtitle: How LINKRIGHTS handles information, in plain language.

sections.title: There are no accounts
sections.body: LINKRIGHTS has no sign-up and no login, so we do not collect names, emails or phone numbers.

sections.title: AI questions are not stored against a person
sections.body: Your question is sent to the AI service (OpenAI) to produce an answer and is not stored linked to any user. Minimal technical records (time and type of an error) may be kept to fix faults.

sections.title: Please do not enter these details
sections.body: Do not type identifying information such as your name, contact details, address, passport number, alien registration number, visa number or medical records. Describing the situation is enough.

sections.title: No advertising or tracking cookies
sections.body: This site carries no advertising and does not use cookies to track visitors.

sections.title: External links
sections.body: The official websites we link to are run by those organisations, and their own privacy policies apply there.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy question, email us at the address in the footer.

footer.aboutSite: LINKRIGHTS is a rights information platform for young people with a migrant background.
footer.notAdvice: Information here is general guidance, not legal or medical advice. Confirm decisions with an official organisation.
